rules.rule: CRM owns service records; AutoStop App owns Store data, Admin V2 estimates, orders and customer-visible quote publication; Gmail and Telegram own their messages and media. Telegram never substitutes for Store publication. Manager keeps only routes, cross-system rules, technical cursors, refs and compact verified lessons. Never persist raw business records, private identifiers, message bodies, financial ledgers, credentials or secrets.

Command routing alone selects ordered workflows, effects, connector needs and write policy. Knowledge lookup only selects documents and cannot grant a write, external send, financial authority or connector access. The configured project surface is the live 24-tool CRM Gateway; internal Manager capabilities remain non-public and production imports only the required subset. codex_apps/autostopcrm.* and unconfigured account App namespaces are legacy and must not be used or reported as project failures.

Every mutation requires an exact focused reread, ActionContractV2, non-mutating dry-run, apply with a different idempotency key and concurrency controls, then independent exact reread. Unverified outcomes remain compensating.

The legacy QuoteOffer path requires has_estimate_draft=false and items_has_more=false; true or absent proof blocks it. A Store quote led by store_quote_conductor instead uses only the dedicated Admin V2 estimate actions and requires an exact current owner read proving AUTOSTOP_MANAGER provenance, no QuoteOffer conflict, complete original-item coverage and current revision. The generic Store owner API is never a public/raw path for this quote flow. It never automatically clears a mixed or manual estimate.

Publish and independently reread the Admin V2 estimate before sending work Telegram. Bind every dialog turn to quote ID, estimate revision and context hash; ledger state is refs-only. An inbound reply is accepted only through a typed adapter's opaque receipt and independent readback proving the same confirmed private peer and delivered-message binding; caller-supplied consent or hashes are not proof. Only unambiguous current consent may create one WAITING_FOR_PAYMENT Store order. Stale, ambiguous or mismatched replies require clarification or handoff.

Payments, cashboxes, refunds, payroll, supplier orders, financial totals, destructive actions and external recipients require exact owner authority. A quote consent creates no more than an unpaid WAITING_FOR_PAYMENT order and never reserves stock, procures, discounts, records payment or sends card requisites. Invoice email delivery additionally requires exact recipient, verified sender, attachment SHA-256, successful QA and separate confirmation for tax or financial mismatch.

Multi-step work uses the Gateway v2 ledger with compact state-versioned checkpoints. Store only refs, hashes, booleans and safe summaries; resume the newest unfinished run before starting a duplicate. Store quote conductor holds one active run per exact quote target.

Preserve dirty work and remote history. Never reset, rebase, force-push, restart services or deploy unless the active owner request explicitly includes that action; release preparation alone leaves deployment pending.
